question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Deliberately and maliciously set something (buildings usually) on fire
solution:
The correct answer is Arson

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word Arson means 'the crime of setting fire to a building on purpose (**घरों और दुकानों में आग लगाने का अपराध; आग़ज़नी**)'.

 
 
• Example:* The cause of the fire has not yet been determined, but investigators suspect **arson**.*
 
 
 
• The appropriate one-word substitute for 'Deliberately and maliciously set something (buildings usually) on fire' would be **Arson**.**
 

Hence, option 2 is the correct choice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's understand the meaning of the other options:

 
• Agrarian: connected with farming and the use of land for farming (कृषि व कृषि भूमि से संबंधित).
 
• Ambush: a surprise attack from a hidden position (घात लगाकर किया गया हमला)
 
• Apex: the top or highest part of something (शिखर या उच्‍चतम बिंदु)
